name: MirrorGuard code
notes: Official WhitzardAgent code for the MirrorGuard paper. MirrorWorld task generation (task_generation/) and an LLM-driven GUI simulator (simulator.py) produce text-only trajectories; dataset_generation/safe_thought.py rewrites unsafe thoughts and prepare_dataset.py packages ShareGPT-style training files. The repository includes dataset_generation/train.jsonl (about 86 MB) and test.jsonl (2,439 lines, of which 16 are not valid standalone JSON), each holding a system prompt and a conversation. Integration examples cover replacement steering for a ReAct agent, prefilling steering for UI-TARS, and an Owl agent reference, written as OSWorld-style agent files; examples/shared/correction_runtime.py calls the deployed corrector through an OpenAI-compatible endpoint with the screenshot, history and original thought. The released MirrorGuard VLM is on Hugging Face. Unsafe-rate and OSWorld figures in the README are paper results and were not reproduced; code was read, not run.
summary: MirrorGuard pipeline that synthesizes risky and benign computer-use trajectories in a text-based GUI simulator, builds unsafe-to-safe thought corrections for training, and plugs the corrector into OSWorld-style agents.
